senses.sense_definition: A small to medium-sized tree-dwelling lizard known for its ability to change the color of its skin, its independently moving eyes, and its long, sticky tongue used for catching prey.

examples.text: The small <w>chameleon</w> blended perfectly into the green leaves of the tree.
We watched the <w>chameleon</w> catch an insect with its long tongue.

senses.sense_definition: A person who easily and frequently changes their opinions, behavior, or appearance to adapt to different situations or please others.

examples.text: He is a political <w>chameleon</w> who modifies his views to suit any audience.
The actor was like a <w>chameleon</w>, completely disappearing into every new role.

senses.sense_definition: A hypothetical scalar particle whose effective mass depends on the local energy density or surrounding environment.

examples.text: The theoretical physicist studied the role of the <w>chameleon</w> in explaining cosmic acceleration.
Experiments were designed to detect the hypothetical <w>chameleon</w> in dense regions.

senses.sense_definition: Able to change or adapt color, appearance, or characteristics according to surroundings or lighting conditions.

examples.text: The sports car featured a striking <w>chameleon</w> paint that shifted from purple to green in the sun.
She wore <w>chameleon</w> fabric that altered its hue based on the surrounding light.
